title: Sesame Crusted Doraji Stir Fry
description: A Chinese-inspired stir fry featuring the unique flavor of doraji, with a crunchy sesame crust. This dish is a great way to experience the delicate taste of doraji.
instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add doraji and cook for 2-3 minutes, until slightly tender.
In a small bowl, mix together sesame seeds and Algerian spices.
Add the sesame seed mixture to the doraji and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add soy sauce and rice vinegar, and stir-fry for another minute.
Transfer the doraji mixture to a serving platter.
Garnish with chopped scallions and serve immediately.
